deploy.startCommand: sh -c 'case "${FORWARDED_ALLOW_IPS:?is required: set railway-private-environment; see docs/deployment-railway.md#trust-upgrade-runbook-59}" in railway-private-environment) trust="*" ;; *"*"*|*/0*) echo "FORWARDED_ALLOW_IPS: no * and no /0... prefix in any spelling; global trust must be spelled railway-private-environment" >&2; exit 64 ;; *) trust="$FORWARDED_ALLOW_IPS" ;; esac; exec uvicorn app.main:app --host "" --port ${PORT:-8080} --proxy-headers --forwarded-allow-ips="$trust"'
